summary: Correlate application stages, typed failures, dependency/worker signals and durable semantic audits; migrate deployment events to native SDLC.

api.reason: Instrumentation repair only; HTTP schemas, authorization and API version remain unchanged.
api.permissions: Existing verified membership, assigned lead scope, private reminders and credentials remain unchanged; no tenant IAM expansion.

metrics.reason: Add bounded DB, worker queue/lag, Gemini usage and typed error dimensions.

traces.reason: Enrich genuine spans and link durable job origin without fabricated parents.

logs.reason: Add correlated allowlisted operation stages, finite error causes and accepted audit projections.

businessEvents.reason: Persist semantic/audit events atomically regardless of SDK availability; stable retry identities and privacy constraints.

deploymentEvents.reason: Native SDLC JSON ingest with service identity and separate strict HTTP202 receipt.

manualVerification: No visible layout change; browser verification checks safe RUM outcomes/properties and actual traceparent/native linkage. Post-deploy tenant searches must prove new metrics/events and SDLC bucket routing; pending evidence stays explicit.
